content.value_statement: Meeting prep often misses prior decisions, risks, and owner context. This skill uses Notion context and Codex research to draft focused agendas and pre-reads.
actual_capabilities: Collects meeting goals, attendees, timing, decisions, and prior materials before drafting.
Searches and fetches relevant Notion pages through Notion MCP tools.
Selects a meeting template for status, decision, planning, retro, one-on-one, or brainstorming sessions.
Drafts Notion agendas and pre-reads with source links, owners, timeboxes, and expected outputs.
Adds concise Codex research with cited claims and separates facts from opinions.
Updates Notion pages as meeting details change and records brief change history.
limitations: Requires a connected Notion MCP server and a successful Notion OAuth login.
Can only access Notion pages allowed by the connected account and workspace permissions.
Does not verify meeting facts beyond supplied Notion content and cited research sources.
Requires user review before sensitive agendas or executive briefings are shared.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Reviews
use_cases.description: Create concise briefings that combine prior Notion notes, decisions, risks, and market context.

use_cases.title: Plan Project Decisions
use_cases.description: Build decision meeting agendas with options, owners, pre-reading, open questions, and expected outcomes.

use_cases.title: Run Better Team Rituals
use_cases.description: Prepare status updates, retrospectives, sprint planning sessions, and one-on-ones from existing team context.

prompt_templates.title: Draft A Basic Agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an agenda for my meeting. Ask for the goal, attendees, date, duration, and any known prior materials before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Notion Pre-Read
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Notion for relevant prior notes and decisions, then create a pre-read with links, key context, risks, and prep asks.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Decision Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a decision meeting brief. Include the decision needed, options, tradeoffs, owners, open questions, and source links from Notion.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich An Executive Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive meeting package using Notion context and Codex research. Separate facts from opinions, cite sources, and include follow-up owners.

output_examples.input: Prepare a 45-minute project decision meeting for product, design, and engineering leads.
output_examples.output: A Notion-ready decision brief with objective, attendee roles, linked background notes, three agenda blocks, decision options, risks, and named owners.

output_examples.input: Create a pre-read for an executive customer review next Tuesday.
output_examples.output: A concise executive pre-read with account context, prior action items, discussion goals, suggested questions, external research notes, and follow-up tracking.

output_examples.input: Help me run a sprint retrospective using our past sprint notes.
output_examples.output: A retrospective agenda with themes from prior notes, timeboxed discussion sections, risks to inspect, and action item owners.

best_practices: Confirm the meeting goal, decisions, attendees, and duration before searching Notion.
Keep every factual claim linked to a Notion page or cited research source.
Review permissions and sensitive content before sharing meeting materials.
anti_patterns: Do not create agendas without confirming the expected outcome and decision owner.
Do not mix research opinions with verified meeting facts.
Do not publish sensitive Notion context to attendees who lack permission.

faq.question: Does this skill require Notion MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs the Notion MCP connection to search, fetch, create, and update Notion pages.

faq.question: Can it create new Notion meeting pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft new Notion pages when the connected account has permission.

faq.question: Does it work for different meeting types?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports status updates, decisions, planning, retrospectives, one-on-ones, and brainstorming sessions.

faq.question: Can it add outside research?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add concise Codex research when helpful and should cite source links.

faq.question: Will it automatically share meeting materials?
faq.answer: No. Users should review content and permissions before sharing any Notion page.

faq.question: What happens if Notion is not connected?
faq.answer: The skill gives setup steps for adding the Notion MCP server and completing OAuth login.
